items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Buckwood; Interviewee responds with a general opinion about Buckwood's career longevity ('He didn't come back at 66...') but provides no evidence of personal interaction, collaboration, or direct relationship.

ctx.x: And, uh, what I can... I mean, if you... you just suggest what you would like to do about it. If you're willing to work with me, whatever, if there's any profit to be made out of it, we'll... We'll... ...split. That's fair enough. That's fair enough, you know, that's... You see? Yeah. Because, uh, I see people as trying to do something and they have nothing to do it with. Yeah. What I'm telling you, there is no lie. Those things is facts. Yeah. You see?
I think one of the best things that we've got out of this is the fact that Buckwood really was as great as, uh, he said he was, because... He proves it, that should prove itself. Yeah. Yeah.
He didn't come back at 66 when he was no good at 30. I've heard...
